increment_1.semantics: Count of rows by type (Head, Note, Section, Item, Other). Deterministic row type classification from BOQRow.row_type field.
increment_1.traceability: EQ-0007 Production Extraction Report, EQ-0009 Context Discovery Report. Row types defined in boq_extraction.py.
increment_1.notes: Frozen structure. Keys: {'Head', 'Note', 'Section', 'Item', 'Other'}. Values: non-negative integers. Sum equals total row count.

increment_1.semantics: Per-section quantity distribution. Outer key: section name. Inner keys: 'negative_qty' (count of rows with quantity < 0), 'positive_qty' (count of rows with quantity > 0).
increment_1.traceability: EQ-0009 Context Discovery Report. Section-based analysis of quantity patterns.
increment_1.notes: Sorted by section name. Only sections with quantities are included. Inner dict always has both 'negative_qty' and 'positive_qty' keys.

increment_1.semantics: BOQ-wide statistics: total_rows, code_rows, description_rows, quantity_rows, uom_rows, section_rows. Count of rows where each field is non-None.
increment_1.traceability: EQ-0007 Production Extraction Report. Field presence analysis.
increment_1.notes: Fixed keys: {'total_rows', 'code_rows', 'description_rows', 'quantity_rows', 'uom_rows', 'section_rows'}. All values are non-negative integers.

increment_1.semantics: Identity-level anomalies detected through deterministic rules. Currently: OMISSION section items with positive quantity (expected negative).
increment_1.traceability: EQ-0009 Context Discovery Report. Omission/Addition domain rules.
increment_1.notes: Each anomaly dict contains: {'row_number': int, 'code': str | None, 'quantity': float, 'section': str}. Sorted by row_number.

increment_2.semantics: Reconstructed BOQ heading tree. Root-level headers (Head1 nodes) with recursive children. None if include_hierarchy=False.
increment_2.traceability: EQ-0010 Spike 4: Hierarchy Reconstruction. Stack-based deterministic algorithm.
increment_2.notes: BOQHeaderNode is frozen dataclass with fields: level, row_number, uom, description, section, depth, parent_row_number, children_headers, children_items. Tree structure reflects Head1-5 nesting.

increment_2.semantics: Statistics derived from reconstructed hierarchy: total_headers, total_items, max_depth, headers_by_level, root_count.
increment_2.notes: None if include_hierarchy=False. Keys: {'total_headers', 'total_items', 'max_depth', 'headers_by_level', 'root_count'}. headers_by_level is nested dict.

increment_3.semantics: Level progression skips detected in hierarchy. Records parent→child transitions where child_level - parent_level > 1 (e.g., Head1→Head3).
increment_3.traceability: EQ-0010 Spike 3: Row Sequence Analysis. EQ-0011 Spike 2: Evidence vs Assessment Decomposition (detection only, not legitimacy).
increment_3.notes: None if include_detection=False. Each dict: {'parent_row': int, 'child_row': int, 'parent_level': int, 'child_level': int, 'skip': int}. No assessment of legitimacy.

increment_3.python_type: tuple[dict[str, int | str | float | None], ...] | None
increment_3.semantics: Items with quantity exactly equal to 0.0. Detection only, no assessment of acceptability.
increment_3.traceability: EQ-0010 Spike 1: Direct Field Observation. EQ-0011 Spike 2: Evidence vs Assessment Decomposition (detection only).
increment_3.notes: None if include_detection=False. Each dict: {'row_number': int, 'code': str | None, 'description': str | None, 'quantity': float, 'uom': str | None, 'section': str | None}.

increment_3.semantics: Structural parent-child level consistency. Reports cases where child header level exceeds parent level (e.g., Head3 under Head2 but child is Head4).
increment_3.traceability: EQ-0010 Spike 4: Hierarchy Reconstruction. EQ-0011 Spike 3: Boundary Validation (structural only, not semantic).
increment_3.notes: None if include_detection=False. Each dict: {'parent_row': int, 'child_row': int, 'parent_level': int, 'child_level': int}. Structural containment only.

increment_3.semantics: Basic completeness: sections that lack measurable items (quantity field present). Detection only, does not assess whether this is acceptable.
increment_3.traceability: EQ-0010 Spike 3: Row Sequence Analysis. EQ-0011 Spike 3: Boundary Validation (basic structural, not project scope).
increment_3.notes: None if include_detection=False. Each dict: {'section': str, 'total_rows': int, 'item_count': int}. item_count=0 indicates no measurable items.
